[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]通过了五年计划议案，禁止使用基本保障生活标准。

我国目前与议案内容相违背，是否要修改对应政策以遵守该议案。
excerpt.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the Five Year Plans resolution, which bans Basic Subsistence living standards.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

texts.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the Five Year Plans resolution, which bans Basic Subsistence living standards.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

label.zh: 服从他们，但只给予最低限度。
label.en: Give them the barest minimum to comply.

label.zh: 我们将保持现有的政策不变。
label.en: We will retain our current policies.
